items.title: Approve the Minutes of the March 11, 2025 Meeting
Appoint Zameel Imaduddin as the District 11 Representative to the Community Advisory Committee

Increase the Amount of the Professional Services Contract with WMH Corporation for the Design Phase for the Yerba Buena Island Multi-Use Path Project for Segments 3 and 4 and Yerba Buena Island Transit Lane
Amend the Prop L 5-Year Prioritization Program for Muni Maintenance, Rehabilitation, and Replacement

Allocate $2,000,000 in Prop L Funds for Three Requests Projects: Prop L: SFMTA: Muni Metro Station Condition Assessment, Monterey Boulevard Pedestrian Safety Improvement [NTP], Embarcadero Mobility Resilience Plan
Award a Two-Year Professional Services Contract to SPTJ Consulting in an Amount Not to Exceed $600,000 for Computer Network and Maintenance Services
BART Financial Outlook / Regional Transportation Measure
Caltrain Financial Outlook / Regional Transportation Measure
Internal Accounting Report, Investment Report, and Debt Expenditure Report for the Six Months Ending December 31, 2024
